content.short: Real-time crypto price API delivering data for over 25 exchanges and 385 coins worldwide.
content.description: Coinlayer offers a one-stop API for real-time and historical cryptocurrency exchange rate data. Designed with developers in mind, it provides a broad set of endpoints, features, and options to tailor requests. The API delivers accurate exchange rate data for more than 385 cryptocurrencies in real time, enabling monitoring of individual values and market-wide rates. Built for simplicity, reliability, and high performance, Coinlayer helps applications stay up to date with fast, dependable pricing information.
content.meta: Coinlayer provides a real-time and historical cryptocurrency exchange rate data API. Discover Coinlayer and other DeFi Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
